items.name: exc_info
items.signature: fn exc_info<'a>(arguments: &'a ruff_python_ast::Arguments, semantic: &model::SemanticModel<'_>) -> Option<&'a ruff_python_ast::Keyword>
items.summary: If the keywords to a logging call contain `exc_info=True` or `exc_info=sys.exc_info()`, return the `Keyword` for `exc_info`.

items.name: is_logger_candidate
items.summary: Return `true` if the given `Expr` is a potential logging call. Matches `logging.error`, `logger.error`, `self.logger.error`, etc., but not arbitrary `foo.error` calls.
